messages:
alex: just merged #4572 (tiny docs tweak) — now main CI is red. noticed failures in the smoke matrix. @kate @sam can someone grab first?

ci-bot: build 4572 on main failed · stage=smoke · shard=kvalloc-2 · link=https://ci.redwood/example/build/4572 · summary=segfault during allocator test

kate: grabbing logs, heading in. any quick suspects?

sam: I see the same. flaky allocator test has popped a couple times recently. I'll queue a single-test run to confirm: `pytest tests/smoke/test_allocator.py::test_kvalloc -q`

alex: thanks. please don't revert yet unless it repeats on a clean run — could be a flake. scheduling a rerun now: `ci-bot: /rerun smoke --shard kvalloc-2`

maya: log tail looks like this:
```
2026-03-18T02:04:12Z [error] kv_alloc.cc:238 assert(ptr != NULL) failed
2026-03-18T02:04:12Z [info] stack: 0x7f3b4c.. allocate_chunk+0x42
2026-03-18T02:04:12Z [warn] oom? requested=2.1GiB available=1.9GiB
```

sam: that OOM-ish message might be masking a race — I've seen allocator assertions after small memory regression. yesterday's perf patch could be related (PR 4569).

kate: can we rerun with smaller shard concurrency to see if it's a contention issue? `ci-bot: /rerun smoke --shard kvalloc-2 --env CI_CONCURRENCY=1`

ci-bot: rerun queued by kate — https://ci.redwood/example/build/4573

alex: and if the single-test passes, let's try a bisect across the last 4 merges. sam — can you kick off a narrow bisect run when you have a passing baseline?

sam: yep. if rerun is green I'll run `./tools/ci-bisect --range HEAD~4..HEAD --test tests/smoke/test_allocator.py::test_kvalloc` and report.

maya: adding :eyes: on infra side — I'll watch for infra noise (node pressure, kernel updates).

kate: heads-up to oncall — this is sticky for deploys. if rerun fails again we'll mark it as blocking and escalate.

alex: good plan. leaving notes in the PR and will pause rolling autopush for a few minutes. thanks all.
